warnings.text:
FilesStore extends Context.Service; in VibeLang a service is a service declaration: service FilesStore { … }.
  No quick fix: its members come from Effect.Success<typeof make>; write them in the declaration. Keep its key in the declaration: static readonly key = "@smthrs/mvp/files/FilesStore".

SecretNotSaved extends Data.TaggedError; in VibeLang an error is an error declaration: error SecretNotSaved { … }.
  Its quick fix writes error SecretNotSaved { code?: Refusal }; vibelang --fix applies every such fix in the project.

SecretsClient extends Context.Service; in VibeLang a service is a service declaration: service SecretsClient { … }.
  No quick fix: move its static members into the declaration. Keep its key in the declaration: static readonly key = "@smthrs/mvp/secrets/SecretsClient".

SessionsUnavailable extends Schema.TaggedError; a schema error declaration, schema error SessionsUnavailable { … }, writes the same failure with its Schema.

This value is an Effect value, but make already runs Effects, so its caller gets this program instead of its result.
  Run it with try to return its result: try the expression. To return the program itself, write the contract.

StoreUnavailable extends Data.TaggedError; in VibeLang an error is an error declaration: error StoreUnavailable { … }.
  No quick fix: an error declaration's tag is its name, so the tag would become "StoreUnavailable" instead of "AboutStoreUnavailable". Keep the class if something depends on that, and silence this line with // @vibelang-diagnostics-next-line EK4830:off.

Effect.provide wraps a program in a call; write it as a block: provide Layer { … }.
  No quick fix: a provide block stands only as a statement or a return; run the call in one, such as a function that returns it.
